$comment: The first composition tried for the sky card, kept to reproduce it: the observer 2200 km from the reference place, which puts the Mississippi beside UMN on the Earth's edge. At this time the Sun is then 8.4° above the edge and the edge is still in daylight, so the air is a pale blue band, not a sunset. Metered exposure, as an ordinary visit has, with the map's credit in the picture.
name: sky-sunset-orbit-umn-on-limb
description: From 400 km, the Mississippi beside UMN on the Earth's edge at 17:16 CDT on 25 October 2026, the Sun 8.4° above it; metered exposure.
